caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a female figure standing on a greenish, rectangular pedestal. The figure is dressed in a knee-length dress with puffed sleeves that is predominantly blue with golden-yellow trim and accents. Across her body is a red sash that drapes from her left shoulder to her right hip. She wears what appears to be golden jewelry, including earrings and a bracelet on her right wrist. Her left arm is bent at the elbow, holding a round object resembling a shallow bowl or plate, while her right arm is raised and bent, holding up a small cylindrical object. The figure’s hair is black, styled in loose curls, and she wears a headdress adorned with three large feathers colored in shades of brown, beige, and red. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and there are no additional objects or decorative elements present. The artist’s signature, “H. Bowman,” is visible in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Cigar Store Indian
